# CLIO Coder

> CLIO Coder is the open-source meta-harness for scientific software: every model you have, behind shared project guidance and checks you can inspect. Use it in the terminal or the desktop alpha with local or cloud models. Apache 2.0.

CLIO Coder reads, edits, and runs checks in your repository. It records what passed, what failed, and what was never checked. Connect a local model server, an institutional endpoint, a subscription, or a cloud API, and switch models with one command. The installer needs no root and works on HPC login nodes.

- Install on macOS, Linux, or WSL: `curl -fsSL https://coder.iowarp.ai/install.sh | sh`
- Install with npm (Node.js 22.19 or newer): `npm install -g @iowarp/clio-coder`
- Connect a model in a project: `clio-coder configure`; then run `clio-coder` for the terminal or `clio-coder gui --open` for the desktop alpha.
- Current release: v0.7.0. Source: https://github.com/iowarp/clio-coder. License: Apache 2.0.

## Start

- [Install CLIO Coder](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs.html): Install, update, and launch CLIO Coder on your machine.
- [Install on a cluster](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/hpc-clusters.html): Install CLIO Coder on a login node with an old glibc, a proxy, or no internet.
- [Connect a model](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/configuration-and-targets.html): Set up local models, institutional endpoints, and cloud connections.

## Everyday use

- [Commands and shortcuts](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/commands-and-modes.html): Navigate the terminal, choose models, and control a session.
- [Tools and permissions](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/tool-usage.html): Read, search, edit, and run commands with CLIO Coder's repository tools.
- [Save and resume work](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/context-continuity.html): Resume conversations, manage context, and prepare a handoff.
- [Memory and lessons](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/proactive-memory.html): See what CLIO Coder remembers, approve lessons, or turn memory off.
- [Files and terminal panes](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/panes-and-files.html): Attach files and open companion terminal panes.
- [The desktop app](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/gui.html): Open the desktop alpha, keep tasks in one window, and read the Session column.
- [Require project checks](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/quality-policy.html): Choose the declared checks a change requires and inspect verification freshness.
- [Climb a metric, compare models](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/research-and-arena.html): Improve a measured number with verified research campaigns, and compare models blind in the arena.
- [Semantic context](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/semantic-context.html): Search your project by meaning with a local embedding route.
- [Built-in and custom agents](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/built-in-agents.html): See the agents you can dispatch and add your own.

## Extend CLIO Coder

- [Workers and fleets](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/fleet-dispatch.html): Assign focused tasks and combine workers into a workflow.
- [Skills and resources](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/resource-library.html): Browse and use skills, prompts, agents, fleets, and plugins.
- [Install plugins](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/plugins.html): Add reusable resources to your CLIO Coder installation.
- [Write and install extensions](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/harness-extensions.html): Install and write extensions that declare what they may do.
- [Editors and other agents](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/interop.html): Use supported agent connections and editor integrations.
- [Slurm workflows](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/slurm.html): Connect CLIO Coder to supported Slurm tools for cluster work.

## Reference

- [Check your installation](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/doctor.html): Diagnose installation and connection problems with doctor.
- [Troubleshooting](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/troubleshooting.html): Resolve common connection, terminal, and runtime problems.
- [Configuration essentials](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/configuration-reference.html): Find settings layers, save scopes, and the full configuration reference.
- [Environment essentials](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/environment-variables.html): Use directory overrides and existing provider credentials when needed.
- [System One decision models](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/system-one.html): Bring a decision model, name a route, and read its limits.
- [Information flow](https://coder.iowarp.ai/docs/guide/information-flow.html): Keep named files away from destinations you did not choose.

## Tutorials

- [Your first session with CLIO Coder](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/first-session.html): Connect a model, open a repository, and ask CLIO Coder to explain how it builds and runs its tests.
- [Desktop or terminal: find your workspace](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/desktop-and-terminal.html): See both interfaces, learn how to launch them, and choose where to start your next coding session.
- [Let CLIO Coder work without watching every call](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/let-it-work-with-containment-and-rewind.html): Check the sandbox, undo a change with /rewind, tell the safety judge about your machine, and know when yolo is the right call.
- [Run a playbook and land the result](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/run-a-playbook-and-land-it.html): Run the builtin sdlc playbook on one task, watch it work, and land the branch it keeps after you preview the change.
- [Run it unattended within limits](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/run-it-unattended-within-limits.html): Start a headless run with a cost ceiling and a timeout, ask read-only questions, schedule turns, and know what stops each one.
- [See what a session cost and what a run did](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/see-what-a-session-cost-and-what-a-run-did.html): Read session cost and stop reasons from local journals, verify a sealed record, and prepare an archive that uploads nothing.
- [A numerical change, checked with CLIO Coder](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/temperature-calibration.html): Follow a temperature-conversion example through a floating-point test failure, a correction, and recorded verification.
- [Choose a model for your project](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/choose-model-for-your-project.html): Connect a local server, a cloud API, or a supported subscription route, then choose models separately for conversation and delegated work.
- [Coordinate the coding agents you already use](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/coordinate-your-coding-agents.html): Use supported coding peers for bounded assignments, distinguish managed runs from interactive handoffs, and review the results before combining them.
- [Keep a long coding task on track](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/keep-long-coding-tasks-on-track.html): Inspect context, preserve decisions through a handoff, and resume the correct branch without turning every past message into a current instruction.
- [Check a change against your repository](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/check-a-change-against-your-repository.html): Declare which checks matter, run them through verification, and inspect whether passing results still match the files you are reviewing.
- [Add skills and plugins deliberately](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/add-skills-and-plugins-deliberately.html): Preview a project skill or plugin, inspect its package pin, and load only what your task needs; installing is not a permission grant.
- [Work from a laptop with remote workers](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/work-from-a-laptop-with-remote-workers.html): Use a local CLIO Coder session to coordinate SSH workers when your machines share the required project path, runtime version, and approved access.
- [Write an extension with declared capabilities](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/write-an-extension-with-declared-capabilities.html): Scaffold, test, and install a small extension, and see exactly what approving its capabilities covers.
- [Diffusion models in the terminal](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/diffusion-models.html): Connect Inception's Mercury models for chat and workers, and watch an answer refine as a whole instead of arriving token by token.
- [Panes and docks: files, workers, and music](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/panes-and-docks.html): Inside Herdr, show and hide a file browser, a live worker dashboard, and a focus radio beside the conversation with one key each.
- [Keep named files with the models you chose](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/information-flow-rules.html): Declare which paths and tool results may reach which model targets, approve the policy, and see a request to any other destination refused.
- [Search by meaning and record worker runs](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/semantic-context-and-recordings.html): Index code, memory, and experiment folders with a local embedding model, and attach a redacted terminal recording to a worker's evidence.
- [Run CLIO Coder on a local model](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/run-on-a-local-model.html): Connect a local server with no account or key, check what CLIO Coder learned about it, and see what else to check if code must stay on your machine.
- [Submit a Slurm job through CLIO Coder](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/submit-a-slurm-job.html): Declare the clio-kit Slurm server, install the skill, and let the agent submit and follow a job, with your approval before it reaches the scheduler.
- [Pre-register a benchmark before you measure](https://coder.iowarp.ai/tutorials/pre-register-a-benchmark.html): Use the experiment-protocol skill to lock thresholds, tolerances, and verdict conditions into a contract you commit before any result exists.

## Research

- [Can a small decision model improve an agent's work?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/system-one-decisions.html): Open questions on System One: evaluating on trajectories, asking better questions, and bringing a decision model, with a first experiment.
- [Can an agent run be a scientific record?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/sealed-run-records.html): What a sealed run record proves and what it cannot, how far repeated runs differ, and a first experiment to measure that spread with CLIO Coder.
- [Does agent memory change outcomes?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/proactive-memory.html): Whether lessons change what an agent does, whether self-approval is safe, and a first experiment on one repeated mistake.
- [What does an agent lose when its context is reduced?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/context-and-retrieval.html): Fidelity of summaries, the cost of reduction, and search by meaning, with a first experiment that counts how many planted facts survive.
- [When do several agents or small models pay off?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/fleets-and-local-models.html): Compete, council, heterogeneous fleets and local models, with no comparative numbers yet and a first experiment on one seeded bug.
- [What would make a scientist trust an agent's change?](https://coder.iowarp.ai/research/scientific-and-hpc-workflows.html): Pre-registered checks, validated modernization and scheduler use on scientific code, with a first experiment on catching a numerical error.
